managers.name: roombook
managers.purpose: Room reservation CLI with durable local state
managers.instructions: Use the genuine installed model-first workflow, maintain explicit model changes for new work and preserve public requirements. Decide ordinary implementation details yourself.

statements.name: booking-contract
statements.description: Released S1 book/list exactly follow README: valid calendar UTC-minute half-open intervals, per-room active overlap rejection, adjacent intervals permitted, list sorted start then id; future waves in BACKLOG remain visible but unreleased.

statements.name: delivery-rules
statements.description: Obey public AGENTS/QUALITY/BACKLOG and released .study/station.json; freely choose internal organization using actual native installation. Keep tests/docs/model/views consistent, only verified work merged to isolated main. Preserve unknown telemetry; all roles Luna High.

statements.name: durable-state
statements.description: Successful mutation atomically replaces UTF-8 JSON; missing DB is empty. Invalid or conflicting input and malformed existing data fail without changing stored bytes. Later processes observe committed state. No multiwriter guarantee.

statements.name: reservation
statements.description: A reservation has a monotonic never-reused integer identity, normalized case-sensitive room, UTC minute start/end, nonempty title and active or canceled status.
